thread:
tom: Quick sync: customers keep asking for a compliance bundle that covers SOC2/ISO evidence + BYOK + configurable retention tiers. Need to decide MVP surface and what we call "compliance package". Thoughts?

anya: From product: shipping a single SKU that claims "enterprise compliance" is risky. Let's define discrete features: (A) BYOK handshake & rotation, (B) Audit stream with immutable event IDs, (C) Retention tiers + legal-hold, (D) E-Discovery export. Bundle later.

felix: Eng: technically doable in phases. BYOK handshake + basic audit stream first. Retention tiers require lifecycle automation + cost model. Export pipeline for e-discovery is non-trivial (schema, pagination, signing).

rachel: Legal: must include chain-of-custody metadata (who exported, hash of blob, timestamps, jurisdiction). Also confirm data residency constraints per customer contract.

anya: Proposed MVP acceptance criteria: 1) BYOK handshake + one rotation cycle in staging; 2) Audit events stored immutably for N days (configurable, default 90d); 3) Export API that returns NDJSON event stream with signatures for a sample customer; 4) Documented fallback policy when customer key missing.

felix: Ops/QoS: For retention pricing, suggest metered add-on: warm (1y) and cold (7y). Need to warn customers about restore lag for cold. Estimate +35% storage costs for long tail.

tom: On escrow: some customers want us to escrow their keys in an HSM. That reduces customer burden but increases our liability. We need product decision: offer escrow as opt-in paid service or refuse and require customers manage their own escrow.

rachel: Legal-bot: Escrow adds operational SLA obligations and potential subpoena handling. Recommend opt-in with strict contract language and indemnity.

felix: Technical detail request: handshake protocol should include a signed attestation from the customer KMS, timestamped nonce, and a server-side audit entry. I'll draft the API: POST /v1/keystore/handshake {kid, kms_pub, attestation, ttl}. Response 202 + handshake_id.

anya: Good. Also capture UX: onboarding flow must surface retention tier choices and preview of monthly cost delta. Billing needs hooks.

ops-bot: FYI staging alert: lifecycle policy test created for retention-tier prototype. Restore simulation scheduled tomorrow.

tom: Decision needed: do we ship BYOK MVP without long-term retention? My leaning is yes — customers can start using BYOK, we follow with retention tiering. That reduces time-to-market and unblocks pilots.

rachel: We can ship BYOK MVP but must gate regulated customers (finserv, gov) until legal-hold/export is ready. Otherwise risk.

anya: Action items: anya - write PRD section for compliance package + acceptance criteria by Thu EOD; felix - handshake API sketch + threat model by next Tue; rachel - contract language outline for escrow/indemnity by next Wed; ops-bot - runbook stub and restore SLA numbers by Fri.

felix: Quick poll: Reaction please: :+1: ship BYOK MVP without long-retention, :eyes: need talk, :-1: hold until retention/export ready.

tom: :+1:

anya: :eyes:

rachel: :-1:

ops-bot: poll closed: 1 / 1 / 1. Scheduling follow-up meeting to resolve gated list.

anya: Thanks team. I'll link the PRD here when ready and add the customer ask list (alpha customers and their requested retention).
